parameters.data_source: DoltHub post-no-preference/options volatility_history pulled 2019-02-09..2026-09-17 (brief T-20261005-44); prices, panel, signals from data/research/equity_book
parameters.definition: iv_current(t) - RV21(t), RV21 = sqrt(252) x std of the last 21 daily log close returns ending at t (equity_book prices)
parameters.ic: daily Spearman rank IC within L12 x coverage (>= 200 names) between the rank-normal signal at t and e(t, j); CIC(a..b) = sum of lag mean ICs; Newey-West t of the per-date lag-sum series (10 lags for CIC(2..6), 25 lags for CIC(2..22))
parameters.sign: +1 (Bali-Hovakimian 2009; OSAP RIVolSpread -1 on realized minus implied)
parameters.target_return: P1 Stage 0 definition: close-to-close stock return beta-hedged with panel beta_252_spy at t (NaN -> 1, clipped -0.5..3) and demeaned within (date, ind_code), lags j = 1..22 after the signal close t, lag 1 split overnight/intraday; no delisting return
parameters.timing: signal date t = as-of session of the DoltHub row from the F2 alignment test (default: the row's own date, the later and conservative choice); decision at the close of t, fill at the close of t+1, so lags >= 2 are implementable; shifted further if dolt_log publication is later than 15:50 ET of t+1 for more than 5% of dates
parameters.universe: L12 (panel adv_rank <= 1000 at the signal date t) intersected with DoltHub volatility_history rows at t (exact symbol match); L1 and L2 reported
parameters.windows: recent 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 decides; stress 2019-02-11..2023-08-31 (Mon/Wed/Fri) diagnostic and sign source for DIV21/DIV5; owner B 2026-07-01..2026-09-15 report-only; nothing after 2026-09-17 is read
